tagline: International Association for Inland Waterway Transport Representation
hero_kpi_rationale: The organization hosts a major annual congress with 225 participants from 11 European countries, demonstrating its central role in representing the inland navigation sector and influencing regional standards and policies.

kpis.name: Annual Congress Participation
kpis.explanation: Total number of participants at the annual IVR Congress representing multiple European countries and stakeholder groups.
kpis.description: The 2024 congress in Frankfurt (May 15-17) brought together 225 participants from 11 European countries, confirming IVR's pivotal role in the inland navigation sector.
kpis.signal: Strong institutional engagement and cross-border participation

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium Attendance
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium held in Antwerp, representing insurance, maritime, and shipping professionals.
kpis.description: First edition of the Loss Prevention Colloquium held on November 4, 2024 in Antwerp with 80 participants from Belgium, the Netherlands, and Germany, covering critical technical and financial topics.
kpis.signal: Successful launch of specialized industry event with strong stakeholder participation

kpis.name: Published Technical Sheets
kpis.explanation: Number of technical guidance documents and recommendations issued to industry stakeholders to support sector standardization and best practices.
kpis.description: The report mentions several new technical sheets issued but without precise quantification. Committees develop and publish recommendations for vessel owners, particularly in infographic format.
kpis.signal: Ongoing documentation of technical standards and policies

kpis.name: International Committee Participation
kpis.explanation: Active participation in key European regulatory and standardization bodies shaping inland waterway transport policy.
kpis.description: IVR actively participates in CESNI (European Committee for Standardization in Inland Navigation) and the Central Commission for the Navigation of the Rhine (ZKR), shaping the sector's technical and environmental standards.
kpis.signal: Active engagement in standardization and regulatory bodies

kpis.description: The annual IVR Congress in Frankfurt (May 15-17, 2024) attracted 225 participants from 11 European countries, featuring workshops on navigating inland waterway sustainability, safety culture, and regulatory frameworks. This marks consistent strong engagement with the organization's core mission of industry representation.

IVR successfully launched its first Loss Prevention Colloquium in Antwerp (November 4, 2024) with 80 participants, covering technical and financial aspects of loss prevention. Eight presentations addressed critical topics including decarbonization impacts, motor valuation, classification societies, and clean shipping solutions.
